speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning. To help me understand your scalp and forehead rash, have you noticed any itching, pain, or hair loss in the affected areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Given the child's age, the seasonal worsening in cold weather, and the family history, I want to rule out seborrheic dermatitis or infantile psoriasis. Have you noticed any flaking or "cradle cap" on the scalp, or is the rash limited to the forehead and scalp?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on scalp and forehead. I also have Erythematous patches, Greasy yellow scales, Worse in cold weather.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Psoriasis.

REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide a close-up photograph of the scalp and forehead showing the erythematous patches and greasy yellow scales.
